guesses.question: In the real-default factory (used only by the production singleton, gated by the typeof jest branch D-012 requires), when require('react-native-keychain') itself throws — native module missing/unlinked, not a getGenericPassword call failure covered by D-004 — should that be caught and fall back to some substitute keychain implementation, mirroring the try/catch-plus-console.warn fallback that MonobankTokenService.ts/MonobankAccountSelectionService.ts use for react-native-mmkv (which D-012's own prose calls 'the same idiom'), or should it propagate uncaught so bootstrap rejects, matching D-006/D-008's fail-closed posture? D-008 explicitly forbids exactly this kind of fallback for the parallel encryptedStore.ts require path; D-012 states no equivalent permission or prohibition for keychainKeyStore.ts, and a silent in-memory fallback here would be a live security regression rather than a stylistic one.
